description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Tyler Technologies develops innovative software solutions for the public sector. The Software Engineer will develop and maintain secure, scalable Corrections Solutions products, collaborate in an agile environment, and contribute to coding, APIs, databases, automation, testing, and technical support.
Software engineer building secure corrections and justice software, APIs, databases, and automated deployments

Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain features for Corrections Solutions products with a focus on security, performance, and testing
• Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering to ensure quality in a fast-paced, agile environment
• Write clean, maintainable code, and conduct thorough code reviews
• Design, implement, actively use, and maintain agentic coding workflows that leverage AI to generate, test, debug, and optimize software solutions
• Automate and improve build and deployment processes to enhance efficiency and reliability
• Design and integrate Web Services/APIs as part of product development
• Work with relational databases (e.g., MySQL) to develop, optimize, and maintain data-driven features
• Identify technical debt and implement solutions to improve team productivity
• Confidently deliver features with minimal guidance and support larger projects
• Participate in on-call rotations to troubleshoot product, security, and urgent engineering issues
• Create and maintain documentation for recurring issues, knowledge transfer and standard procedures

Requirements:
• 1-3 years of professional software development experience, including designing, building, and maintaining SaaS applications
• Fundamental understanding of software engineering principles, design patterns, and scalable architecture
• Experience working with relational databases, including schema design, querying, and performance tuning
• Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and cloud-native development practices
• Experience with agentic coding tools and AI-assisted software development workflows, including the ability to leverage AI systems to generate, debug, and optimize code
• Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps workflows
• Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams
• Proven ability to prioritize and deliver quality software in an Agile environment
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
• This is a hybrid position which requires the candidate to be local to the Plano,TX or Franklin, TN office 3 days per week
• We are not considering candidates who require visa sponsorship for this position

Preferred:
• Experience with Node.js
• Familiarity with Web Services, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, and experience with automating build and deployment processes
